scope: Post-H0.0 canonical planning handoff synchronized to project registry generation 71. Preserve verified H0.0 as history and prepare a fresh-current-main H0.1 execution branch only after checkpoint integration; this Work Order does not create or execute C22 runtime.
required_outputs: Fresh post-checkpoint H0.1 execution epoch/control branch
Director-dispatched bounded C22 child Work Order
stop_conditions: Any runtime/domain change is attempted under this planning Work Order
C22 branch creation is attempted before a fresh post-checkpoint H0.1 execution epoch and Director dispatch
PC0 has an unresolved blocking RED
risk_reasons: H0.1 is the first controlled runtime-development pilot.
Incorrect handoff could authorize runtime from stale main or bypass H0.0 evidence.
Exact registry and main identity are checkpoint-critical.

design_brief.problem_statement: The project checkpoint must record current live H0/G facts in registry generation 71 while preserving H0.0 R3 immutable evidence and keeping C22 runtime closed.
design_brief.current_behavior: H0.0 is terminal CHECKPOINT_PROPOSED and G8 is fully accepted/frozen; the pre-checkpoint main registry generation 70 still described older H0/G states.
design_brief.desired_behavior: The checkpoint candidate carries registry generation 71 with synchronized H0/G state, and Status/Plan/Resume select an H0.1 planning handoff with zero runtime workers. After merge, the pre-merge pointer is stale by design and cannot authorize runtime; a fresh post-checkpoint H0.1 execution branch must be created from exact new main.
alternatives_considered: Allow the pre-merge planning pointer to execute runtime
Synchronize registry and create a matching planning-only H0.1-R5 handoff
design_brief.selected_design: Advance the candidate registry to generation 71, create H0.1-R5 with matching registry identity and base current main 82835a37, keep state PLANNED and runtime workers zero, then require a fresh post-merge H0.1 execution branch for C22.
design_brief.why_selected: It records the actual project achievement in machine truth while preserving fail-closed runtime authorization and immutable H0.0 evidence.
non_goals: No mutation of H0.0 R3 evidence
expected_risks: Main moves again before human merge gate
Runtime branch is created from pre-merge pointer
Central registry and handoff epoch diverge
validation_plan: Validate registry, H0.1-R5 epoch/work-order/event and output contracts
Require Plan=H0.1 PLANNING_ONLY with zero runtime workers and FORBIDDEN_UNTIL_DISPATCH
Run Status/Plan/Resume on exact Windows candidate
Re-read main and PR head immediately before human merge

notes: Planning handoff only. Runtime remains closed. The actual H0.1 execution epoch is created from exact post-checkpoint main after this control-only checkpoint is integrated.
